a: Device code flow lets TVs/CLIs authorize via a browser on another device.
Rotate refresh tokens and detect reuse to limit stolen-token damage.
aud must match the intended API; reject tokens for other audiences.
iss identifies the auth server; verify it against an allowlist.
Request and grant only the OAuth scopes required for the task.
Public clients cannot keep secrets; use PKCE instead of client secrets.
RFC 8707 resource indicators bind tokens to specific APIs.
Sender-constraining tokens (DPoP/mTLS) reduces pure bearer-token theft risk.
RP-initiated logout ends the app session and optionally the IdP session.
Sessions are server-side and easier to revoke; tokens are often stateless.
